headline: Transforming Meetings from Talk to Artifacts
subtitle: Turning spoken intent in Teams into instant, enterprise-ready documents
story: Cover slide that immediately states the vision: use AI inside Teams to convert live discussions into structured, editable artifacts, framing the rest of the narrative.
visual_design: Centered title and subtitle with small footer for team names and date; optional thin band at bottom highlighting 'Doc Co-creation Agent in Teams'

headline: Manual document creation is draining high-value time
subtitle: Knowledge workers spend disproportionate effort on formatting, layout and storytelling vs. strategic work
story: SITUATION: Establish the impact-first status quo: meetings and knowledge work culminate in decks and docs, yet creating them is slow, manual, and cognitively expensive, pulling talent away from high-value thinking.
visual_design: Simple bar or pie chart framework: visual split of work time (e.g., 'thinking vs. formatting vs. storytelling') plus 2–3 text callouts on time drain, blank-page paralysis, and design skill gap

headline: The meeting–document gap is now a competitive liability
subtitle: Human bottlenecks delay execution while AI-native competitors capture value faster
story: COMPLICATION: Highlight the 'villain'—the growing gap between rich meeting discussions and delayed artifacts—framed as active loss: slower execution, more friction, and vulnerability versus AI-native tools like Gemini and Gamma.
visual_design: Cause–effect chain (horizontal flow) showing: Live meeting → Manual translation → Delayed PPT/specs/ADO → Slower execution & lower Copilot value; annotate with competitor references (Gemini, Gamma 70M users) and '30M PPT/day' to show scale of exposed surface area

headline: Embedding an AI doc co-creation agent in Teams closes the gap
subtitle: Use Teams’ unique data and collaboration surface to turn spoken intent into instant PPT/Word artifacts
story: ANSWER (early reveal): Position the core proposal succinctly—an AI doc co-creation agent inside Teams that listens to meetings and chats, then generates high-fidelity, editable PPT/Word outputs—framed as the direct resolution to the meeting–document gap.
visual_design: Before/after two-column framework: Left 'Today: Talk → Notes → Manual Docs'; Right 'With Agent: Talk → Instant PPT/Word/ADO updates'; a concise punchline banner at bottom (e.g., 'Punchline #1: Spoken intent becomes immediate output in Teams.')

headline: Real-time doc creation in Teams unlocks new revenue and stickiness
subtitle: A ‘one-click to PPT’ killer app that drives Copilot ARPU and Teams usage
story: ANSWER – BUSINESS IMPACT: Quantify and interpret the opportunity: 30M PPTs/day and 70M Gamma users prove demand; tightly integrate doc creation into Teams to justify Copilot pricing, deepen the Microsoft moat, and make Teams the OS of work.
visual_design: Strategy flywheel or virtuous cycle: 'One-click to PPT' → Higher Copilot perceived value (ARPU uplift) → More meetings/docs in Teams (data gravity) → Better AI outputs → Stronger ecosystem and retention; annotate with '30M PPT/day' and 'Gamma 70M users' as proof points

headline: PPT Maker in Teams turns discussions into co-created artifacts
subtitle: Integrated UI for live generation, review and collaborative editing of PPT/Word
story: ANSWER – USER EXPERIENCE: Describe the concrete product experience: a 'PPT Maker' surface in Teams with conversation panel, live slide preview, and collaborative controls that unify meeting discussion and doc creation into a single workflow.
visual_design: End-to-end user journey swimlane: 1) Join Teams meeting, 2) Invoke PPT Maker, 3) Agent drafts slides/specs from live conversation and context, 4) Participants edit together in real time, 5) Final PPTX/DOCX saved to ecosystem; annotate core UI elements (conversation panel, preview, controls)

headline: A modular orchestration pipeline makes the agent buildable now
subtitle: Dispatcher, Miner, Weaver, Structurer and Assembler turn enterprise data into high-fidelity artifacts
story: ANSWER – FEASIBILITY DEEP DIVE: Demonstrate that the solution is technically grounded and decomposed into clear components—Orchestrator, Miner, Weaver, Structurer, Assembler, and rendering engine—leveraging Teams’ multi-modal data to produce PPTX/DOCX/HTML/MP4.
visual_design: Layered architecture diagram (Deep Dive) showing: Top: User intent (slides, instructions, meeting context) → Orchestrator/Dispatcher; Middle: Miner → Content Pool → Weaver & Structurer; Bottom: Assembler → Engine (HTML, FFMPEG, python-pptx) → Artifacts (PPTX, DOCX, HTML, MP4); use a process flow or Sankey-style arrows to show orchestration

headline: Teams’ data, formats and AI stack create a defensible moat
subtitle: Only Microsoft can combine live meeting data with native Office formats at scale
story: ANSWER – MOAT & POSITIONING: Articulate why Microsoft is uniquely positioned: Teams as the meeting surface, native ownership of PPTX/DOCX standards, and Copilot as the AI layer enable seamless, editable artifact generation that competitors like Zoom/Slack/Gemini cannot easily replicate.
visual_design: Competitive advantage table (columns: Microsoft, Zoom, Slack, Point Solutions like Gamma) vs. rows: 'Live meeting data', 'Native Office formats (PPTX/DOCX)', 'Integrated AI (Copilot)', 'Collaborative editing in same app'; highlight Microsoft’s full-stack checkmarks; bottom banner punchline #2: 'Punchline #2: Teams is the only place where the meeting, the AI and the document are truly one stack.'

headline: Targeted investment and design rigor de-risk the WOW factor
subtitle: Focused team to solve narrative quality, aesthetics and evaluation at scale
story: ANSWER – RISKS & MITIGATION: Acknowledge key challenges—achieving WOW-quality aesthetics, systematic narrative, evaluation metrics, and limited current ownership—and show how dedicated dev and design resources will address them while enabling extensibility to other Microsoft apps.
visual_design: Risk–mitigation matrix (rows: Aesthetic quality, Narrative coherence, Evaluation/datasets, Ownership/resources; columns: Risk, Impact, Mitigation); include explicit resourcing line-item callout: 'Ask: 6 devs (3 senior+) + dedicated designer for eval metrics and UX'; optional note on openness to integrate with existing services (e.g., Societas)

headline: Decision: Fund the Teams doc co-creation agent as a Copilot killer app
subtitle: Approve resources to move from prototype architecture to in-product pilot
story: ENDING – COMMIT: Convert the narrative into a concrete decision: secure dev and design resources to build and pilot the agent in Teams, with clear focus on Copilot monetization, Teams stickiness, and extensibility across Microsoft 365.
visual_design: Action-oriented checklist or mini roadmap: 1) Approve 6 devs (3 senior+) + designer, 2) Define aesthetic and narrative evaluation metrics, 3) Build pilot in Teams meetings/channels with PPT Maker UI, 4) Measure impact on Copilot usage and Teams engagement; final punchline #3 banner: 'Punchline #3: If the best way to write a doc is to have a meeting in Teams, we win the OS of work.'
